description: The cockpit window may call the app's own commands, plus exactly one plugin command: opening a repo row's GitHub Actions page. Every `settings_*`, `cockpit`, `containers`, `repos`, `runners`, `usage`, `azure_cost` and `openclaw` command is app-defined, which Tauri's ACL always permits without a grant, and the frontend calls no Tauri-provided `core:*` API -- so `core:default` stays out, and with it the window, webview, app, event, menu, tray, image, path and resources defaults this app never uses. The one entry below is the whole widening; `app/README.md`'s 'The one granted capability' section accounts for it line by line, and `github::actions_url` is the only thing that composes a URL for it. `tauri-plugin-notification` is a dependency and is granted NOTHING: needs-approval banners are built and shown in Rust, so the webview never invokes it. VERIFICATION STATUS: the scope glob is unit-tested against every URL the Repos panel can emit and against a list it must refuse (`actions_url_is_the_only_shape_the_granted_scope_admits`), but that test reads this file -- it does not exercise the IPC boundary that enforces it. Nothing automated does (issue #123). The only check that exercises the real boundary is the manual smoke test in `app/README.md`; run it after editing this file.
